title: C: Pub/Sub Broker
description: Implement a publish/subscribe message broker that manages topics and delivers messages to subscribers.

steps.title: Topic Subscription
steps.description: Define a `Subscriber` struct with id and callback function pointer. Define a `Topic` struct with name, subscriber array, and count. Write `void topic_subscribe(Topic *t, Subscriber *s)` and `void topic_publish(Topic *t, char *msg)`. Test with a 'news' topic and 2 subscribers.

verification.failureMessage: Publish a message and deliver to both subscribers
